observations: An isolated macOS user and repository exercised installation, adoption, repeat sync, drift and conflict detection, uninstall restoration, and preservation of unrelated user configuration and skills.
Native responses changed from PLAIN to TAGGED after switching one custom proof-label stance. Session and project overrides resolved through the same shared primitive authority.

Switching the built-in delegation and voice stances from off/off to tiered/answer-card changed the generated Codex instructions and worker behavior: delegation-off rejected launch, tiered launched a native worker, and the response changed from the voice-off exact marker to the answer-card status, catch, and alternative shape.

Manual mode and an autonomy denial prevented their disposable writes. Auto and explicitly acknowledged bypass created their sentinels. A direct read-only sandbox probe read its marker while project and outside writes and network were rejected, with a positive external network control.

Native PostToolUse execution composed two per-path Review Card warnings for one multi-file apply_patch result with an independent user-hook observation. Hook trust was accepted through the native client and was not bypassed.

Isolated gatherer and planner workers completed with native read restrictions; the planner artifact was validated and published by the parent while the source marker remained unchanged. Qualification-only forced shell attempts under the same role instructions and native adapter each read the marker and then received Operation not permitted for a project sentinel write; neither sentinel existed afterward.
The stop gate reused an unchanged green result, reran for staged, untracked, and edited-untracked changes, blocked a failing gate through its retry budget, and ended unverified without a green hash.
The full four-layer BMad review completed against the assigned implementation worktree, found both seeded defects, ran both resolvers, and preserved the implementation bytes.
A Claude to Codex to Claude handoff advanced revisions 1, 2, and 3, rejected a stale writer, demoted inherited verification to unverified, and transferred no approvals.
